prompt: Tam thức bậc hai nào sau đây luôn nhận giá trị dương với mọi <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow></semantics></math>?
solution: Tam thức <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></semantics></math> có hệ số <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math> và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>Δ</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math> nên <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mspace width="0.167em"/><mo>∀</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow></semantics></math>.
